observations: Live macOS sender sample: 9 FPS versus 30 target, 0.2 kbps, 5.4 ms RTT, EXCELLENT connection, adaptation none; neighboring sample had 17 FPS.
Live Android sender samples: 2-5 FPS versus 15 target over several 5-second samples, 0-0.2 kbps, 7-13 ms RTT, adaptation none.
Neither sampled sender trace contained packet_loss_percent. Live Grafana panel lacked the loss column present in repository dashboard JSON.
root_cause: Bundled Flutter WebRTC sends RTCStats timestamp_us; native reporter treated it as milliseconds. This divides computed bitrate by about 1000 and prevents the 9-12 second loss window from completing. The traces do not establish why actual FPS was below the selected maximum profile.
